chapter.title: The Dice Game
chapter.description: Yudhishthira is drawn into a rigged game of dice by Shakuni. The Pandavas lose everything — their kingdom, their freedom, and finally Draupadi.

panels.action: Duryodhana and Shakuni stand at the entrance of the grand dice hall, torchlight casting long shadows behind them. Duryodhana's smile is cold and calculated.
panels.environment: Hastinapur palace dice hall — vast stone columns, oil lamps, a central gaming table of dark wood inlaid with ivory.
panels.lighting: Dramatic torchlight from wall sconces, deep shadows in corners, warm amber glow on their faces.
panels.camera: Low angle wide shot, characters silhouetted against the hall entrance.

dialogue.speaker: Shakuni
dialogue.text: The game is already won, nephew. All that remains is for them to play it.

panels.action: Yudhishthira walks through the palace corridor, dressed in white. His expression is calm but his eyes carry the weight of duty.
panels.environment: Hastinapur palace corridor — marble floors, carved pillars, morning light through latticed windows.
panels.lighting: Soft cool morning light from the left, gentle shadows.
panels.camera: Medium shot, slightly low angle, character walking toward camera.
panels.mood: Dignified calm, unaware of the trap ahead.

dialogue.speaker: Yudhishthira
dialogue.text: A king does not refuse a royal invitation. It is dharma.

panels.action: Extreme close-up on Shakuni's eyes — sharp, calculating, gleaming with barely-concealed malice.
panels.environment: Dice hall — blurred background of torchlight.
panels.lighting: Single torch reflection in both eyes, dramatic rim light.

panels.action: Shakuni's dice in close-up — ornate ivory dice, slightly marked.
Yudhishthira's hand reaching for the dice — steady, unaware.
panels.lighting: Warm amber, slightly softer than panel 04.

panels.action: Duryodhana seated at the table, leaning forward with his chin resting on folded hands, watching.
panels.environment: Dice hall, from across the table.

panels.action: Wide shot of the dice hall — three figures at the gaming table, court observers watching from the sides in silence.
panels.environment: Full dice hall, high ceiling, torches, observers on both sides.
panels.lighting: Central light over table, dark periphery.

panels.action: Yudhishthira sits across from Shakuni at the table. The first throw has been made. Yudhishthira stares at the dice showing a loss.
panels.environment: Dice hall — close on the table between the two men.
panels.lighting: Torchlight, harsh shadows emphasising the stakes.

dialogue.speaker: Shakuni
dialogue.text: Indraprastha is a worthy opening stake, cousin. Shall we continue?

dialogue.speaker: Yudhishthira
dialogue.text: I cannot stop now. To walk away would dishonour us both.

panels.action: Yudhishthira's face — sweat on his brow, eyes fixed on the dice. The cracks are showing.
panels.lighting: Torchlight, harsh from above, deep shadows under his eyes.

panels.action: Shakuni throws the dice — his wrist loose, his smile easy, utterly in control.
panels.lighting: Flash of lamplight catching the ivory dice.
panels.camera: Medium shot — dice and hand in foreground, Shakuni's pleased face behind.

panels.action: Dushasana drags Draupadi into the dice hall by her hair. The court watches in stunned silence. Yudhishthira is frozen, his hands gripping the table. Duryodhana laughs.
panels.environment: The full dice hall — every observer visible, the moment of total collapse.
panels.lighting: Brutal torchlight, no mercy in the shadows, the central moment fully lit.
panels.camera: Wide dramatic shot — Draupadi centre, Dushasana behind, Yudhishthira left, Duryodhana right.

dialogue.speaker: Draupadi
dialogue.text: Is there no dharma left in this hall? No king here who will speak?

panels.action: Yudhishthira's face in the aftermath — eyes downcast, hollowed, the dice still in his open palm.
panels.lighting: Single torch, side-lit, deep shadow on half his face.
panels.mood: Total collapse of self, silent grief.

panels.action: Bhima's fists clenched at his sides, trembling with barely-controlled rage. His jaw is set.
panels.environment: Side of the dice hall — observers' area.

dialogue.speaker: Bhima
dialogue.text: I will burn these hands that lost her. I swear it.

panels.action: Draupadi stands alone in the centre of the hall — dishevelled but unbowed. Her eyes carry fire, not defeat. The court is silent around her.
panels.environment: Full dice hall, all figures in background, Draupadi centre foreground.
panels.lighting: A single shaft of light from above falls on her — the only warmth in the scene.
panels.camera: Low angle wide shot, Draupadi dominant in frame.

dialogue.speaker: Draupadi
dialogue.text: Remember this day, Kuru elders. What is begun here will end in fire.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.text: The war had its first cause.
